notes: ἐνώπιον is `unrepresented` under rule 36's absorbed-into-a-predicate arm: the ASV makes πλῆθος the direct object of *pleased* and realizes the improper preposition nowhere, so rules 42 and 71 do not arise, no English phrase rendering the adverb. Stretching *pleased* over it is the competing reading and rule 36 forbids it.
πνεύματος ἁγίου is anarthrous, so the supplied *the* belongs to the noun under rule 58 and rides discontinuously around *Holy* with the case preposition, leaving ἁγίου a bare *Holy*.
παντὸς τοῦ πλήθους splits under rules 19 and 26 — *the* to the article, *whole* to the quantifier, *multitude* to the noun; no negator stands, so rule 87 is not in question.
